lane4.title: 8-Gate Visual Proof Round
lane4.method: Dev server (Vite 5.4.21, port 5173) + fetch_webpage content verification + Phase 14 screenshot corpus + view_image visual confirmation

gate1_shell_chrome.description: Shell chrome intact on home surface
gate1_shell_chrome.evidence: fetch_webpage http://localhost:5173/ — top bar renders: 'TerraFusion OS', 'Benton County', 'Assessment', 'Tax Year 2026', ⌘K command palette, SENTINEL status bar, system time. Home content: recent parcels, quick actions, today's work, map layers.

gate2_workbench_tier0.description: Property Workbench opens as Tier-0 maximized host
gate2_workbench_tier0.evidence: fetch_webpage http://localhost:5173/property/1234567890 — 9 canonical tabs rendered: Sum|Forge|Atlas|Dais|Clerk|Treas|Audit|Dossier|Pilot. 5 work modes: Overview|Valuation|Mapping|Admin|Case. Suite Compass left rail. Parcel context (ID, address, owner, values). Ask Pilot button. Activity panel.

gate3_parcel_scoped_routing.description: Parcel-scoped suites (forge/atlas/dais/dossier) land in correct Workbench tabs

evidence.forge: fetch_webpage /property/1234567890/forge → TerraForge rendered inside 9-tab workbench. Content: valuation parameters, explain valuation, value change analysis, income approach, model inputs, value history trend. Screenshot: phase14-staging-forge-click.png confirms golden/amber theme, Suite Compass highlights TerraForge 'Build value'.
evidence.atlas: fetch_webpage /property/1234567890/atlas → TerraAtlas rendered inside 9-tab workbench. Content: map layers (Parcel Boundary, Zoning, Flood Zone, Aerial Imagery), query layers. Screenshot: phase14-staging-atlas-click.png confirms teal theme, Suite Compass highlights TerraAtlas 'See the county'.
evidence.dais: fetch_webpage /property/1234567890/dais → TerraDais rendered inside 9-tab workbench. Content: workflow parameters, PILT calculator, senior/disabled exemption, levy rate components, commissioner memo, value change notice, BOE evidence packet, appeal response, certification, queue management. Screenshot: phase14-staging-dais-click.png confirms purple theme, Suite Compass highlights TerraDais 'Operate value'.
evidence.dossier: fetch_webpage /property/1234567890/dossier → TerraDossier rendered inside 9-tab workbench. Content: document management, evidence snapshot, evidence synthesis, casefile summary, add case note. Screenshot: phase14-staging-dossier-click.png confirms green theme, Suite Compass highlights TerraDossier 'Prove the decision'.

gate4_standalone_workspace.description: Suite-workspace surfaces open as standalone (not in workbench)

evidence.forge_standalone: fetch_webpage http://localhost:5173/forge → TerraForge standalone home. Content: CostForge, CompsForge, Income Valuation, Comparable Sales, AppealForge, Reconciliation, Value Audit, Governed Run, Regression Studio, Statistics Studio, TerraGAMA. NO 9-tab workbench strip. NO Suite Compass.
evidence.gpt_standalone: fetch_webpage http://localhost:5173/gpt → TerraGPT standalone home. Content: GPT Studio, GPT Marketplace, GPT Management, GPT Builder, GPT Analytics, RAG Datasets. NO 9-tab workbench strip. NO Suite Compass.
evidence.router_truth: Router.tsx lines 173-177: /forge → ForgeHome, /atlas → AtlasHome, /dais → DaisHome, /dossier → DossierHome, /gpt → GptHome — all register as standalone routes separate from /property/:parcelId workbench routes.

gate5_taskbar_running_active.description: Taskbar running/active state matches open/focused windows

evidence.visual: Phase 14 screenshots: Suite Compass highlights active suite with cyan/green accent + subtitle text (e.g., 'Build value', 'See the county', 'Operate value', 'Prove the decision'). Non-active suites are dimmed.
evidence.contract: Lane 2 tests (32/32 PASS): isRunning(moduleId) returns true when window exists, isActive(moduleId) returns true when moduleId matches activeWindowId. Tests cover parcel-scoped routing (moduleId='property-workbench'), suite-workspace standalone, and toggle-minimize behavior.

Lane 1 tests (16/16 PASS): windowLifecycleEvents.contract.test.ts proves every lifecycle action (open, close, focus, minimize, maximize, restore) emits the correct ShellEvent with proper type, windowId, moduleId, and detail metadata.
specific_tests: window_closed fires on closeWindow() with correct moduleId
window_focused fires with restoredFromMinimized flag when focusing minimized window
spawn_rejected fires for unauthorized module IDs

gate7_workbench_reuse.description: Routing to existing Workbench reuses it — no duplicate leak

evidence.visual: All 16 Phase 14 screenshots show the SAME 9-tab workbench host across all tab clicks. Tab strip persists. Parcel context ('10001 Benton County') remains constant.
evidence.contract: Lane 2 test 'all parcel-scoped routes reuse same workbench instance': opens forge then atlas — verifies only 1 window exists with moduleId='property-workbench'. Lane 3 test: every module routed to workbench also passes validateWorkbenchHost (12/12 PASS).
evidence.codex_truth: evaluateSpawnIntent() in objectPlacement.ts: parcel-scoped-app modules (forge/atlas/dais/dossier) are classified with hostSurface='tier0-workbench' → route-to-workbench intent. desktopStore.openWindow() finds existing workbench, injects _routedTab metadata, focuses existing window.

evidence.screenshots: 16 Phase 14 screenshots (8 staging + 8 production) covering all 9 workbench tabs
evidence.live_verification: 4 fetch_webpage captures (home, workbench, forge tab, atlas tab, dais tab, dossier tab, forge standalone, gpt standalone)
evidence.contract_tests: 60 new tests across 3 lanes (16+32+12), all PASS
evidence.existing_tests: 41 desktopStore.test.ts PASS, 30 workbench-host-boundary.test.mjs PASS, 54 phase83-tools.test.mjs PASS
